claim: Tenant must pay monthly rent of $3,500 on or before the first day of each calendar month.
source_span: Tenant shall pay to Landlord as Base Rent the sum of $3,500 per month, payable in advance on the first day of each calendar month.
notes: Exact numerical, obligor, and deadline match with lease terms.

claim: Employee is subject to a 12-month post-termination non-solicitation covenant.
source_span: During the term of employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, Executive shall not solicit any customer or employee of the Company.
notes: Captures restrictive covenant duration and scope accurately.

claim: Receiving Party may freely disclose confidential information to any third party at will.
source_span: Receiving Party shall hold and maintain the Confidential Information in strictest confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party.
notes: Citation validity is VALID (span exists), but grounding correctness is FALSE because the claim states the opposite of what the source text obligates.
